preserveIntent.originalMessage: Using SNDK-like assumptions (+15% sales CAGR, 80%+ GM, 50%+ FCF margin), MU EPS power could be $230+, growing at a 34% CAGR FY26-30
preservedElements: Both series: consensus path and SNDK-like path
FY26E and FY27E shared by both scenarios
BofA Global Research, Bloomberg and Visible Alpha attribution
changedElements: Layout: one row of the source table isolated into a single chart
Labels: direct line-end labels instead of a legend round trip
Color: two colors only, blue for consensus and red for the SNDK-like path
preserveIntent.notes: Exhibit 1 is a printed table, so every value is copied verbatim from its cell. Nothing was estimated or re-rounded.
